question: Whose future was the 'World of Tomorrow'? Who was included and who was left out of the visions presented at the 1939 fair?

sections.heading: Whose Future Was It?
sections.focus: English: This section must answer who was included and who was left out of the visions presented at the 1939 fair, considering the social and political context.

sections.heading: Transportation in the World of Tomorrow
sections.focus: English: This section must answer how transportation exhibitions like Futurama depicted the future of mobility and the corporate intentions behind them.

sections.heading: Future Cities and Infrastructure
sections.focus: English: This section must answer how exhibitions like Democracity envisioned urban planning and infrastructure in the future.

sections.heading: Home and Daily Life in the Future
sections.focus: English: This section must answer how the fair showcased advancements in household appliances and materials that would shape future domestic life.

sections.heading: Media and Communication's Future
sections.focus: English: This section must answer how the fair's exhibitions depicted the future of media and communication technologies.
